# Third-Party Dependencies

This folder is intentionally empty in Git.

To build Battle Creator, install/download the ScriptHookRDR2 SDK locally and either:

- set `SCRIPTHOOKRDR2_SDK` to the SDK folder that contains `inc/natives.h`;
- set `SCRIPTHOOKRDR2_LIB_DIR` to the folder that contains `ScriptHookRDR2.lib`; or
- place the SDK at `third_party/ScriptHookRDR2_SDK`.

Do not commit ScriptHookRDR2 binaries, import libraries, game files, or other third-party redistributables unless their license explicitly allows it.
